availability.note: CarsGuide current range lists Plus Single Motor $106,990 and Ultra Twin Motor Performance $134,990 only; CarExpert 2027 page lists Plus and Ultra; CarsGuide reviewed the single-motor Plus 20 Oct 2026. volvocars.com/au configurator returned 403 to automated reads

listPrice.note: '$106,990 before on-road costs' in words (MY27, replaces Plus Twin Motor). Corroborated by CarsGuide review MSRP table. CarExpert 2027 drive-away $114,709 vs app VIC drive-away $112,364 (+$2,346), the same ~$2.3-2.6k gap as Ultra (+$2,569) and MY26 Plus (+$2,601), i.e. dealer delivery, consistent with this list price

batteryKwh.note: usable 88.0 kWh, nominal 92.0 kWh on the same page (MY26-27). Electrive reports 90 kWh net from Volvo spec; matches sibling volvo-es90 single motor at 88

rangeKm.note: '479km of WLTP range' for the AU Plus Single Motor; also CarsGuide. Equals EV Database WLTP TEH 298 mi (480 km); EU 'up to' 572 km is the TEL best case. Lower than the best case, so a WLTP-derived local figure per the direction test

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: CarsGuide: claimed 21.6 kWh/100km combined. This is WLTP grid energy incl. charging losses at the TEH end: EV Database rated TEH 348 Wh/mi = 21.6 kWh/100km (same end as the 479 km range). Battery/range = 18.4 (vehicle consumption excl. charging losses); same quantity convention as the held twin-motor row (22.8)

bootLitresSeatsUp.note: 324 L with all seats up (CarsGuide range page, both grades); matches held Volvo AU figure

bootLitresSeatsDown.note: Held figure from Volvo AU specifications page (researched 2026-08-06); volvocars.com/au returned 403 this run. Body unchanged for MY27 (Redbook via CarExpert: only battery/powertrain and Ultra Nappa changed). Sources measure folded volume differently (CarExpert 1915 L two-seat on MY25 car, EV Database 1955 L max), so not re-verified

towKg.note: braked 1,500 kg; Electrive gives 1.5 t Single Motor vs 2.2 t Twin Motor; CarExpert 2027 page gives range 1,500-2,200 kg with Ultra at 2,200. CarsGuide and CHOICE show 2,200 for the single motor, rejected (CarsGuide spec table mixes in twin-motor data)

warrantyYears.note: 5 years/unlimited km vehicle warranty, 8-year battery; also CarsGuide 20 Oct 2026 review

insuranceAnnual.note: anchored to kia-ev9-earth-awd ($106,500, 2600) and volvo-es90-ultra-single-motor ($107,990, 2750); below the held EX90 Plus Twin ($124,990, 2900)

depreciationCurve.note: Kept the held steep Volvo EX90 curve: Volvo cut the entry price by $18,000 within about a year (Plus Twin $124,990 -> Plus Single $106,990, CarExpert 29 Jun 2026) and the MY26 400V->800V switch orphans launch cars; in line with volvo-es90 [1,0.67..0.34]/[1,0.64..0.31] and polestar-3 [1,0.66..0.33]
